mapper.select: select count(*) from cart where POP_ID = #{popId} and MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

select c.CART_ID, m.NICKNAME, p.PRODUCT_TITLE, po.OPTION_NAME, po.OPTION_PRICE, c.QTY,OPTION_PRICE * c.QTY as total_price from cart c join member m on m.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID join OPTIONDETAIL od on od.POP_ID = c.POP_ID join PRODUCTOPTION po on po.OPTION_ID = od.OPTION_ID join product p on p.product_id = od.product_id where m.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
